name: A 1604-Concept Obstruction with Three Forced Canonical Phases
definition: Start with the certified 577-concept forbidden graph three-core $B$, form its 579-concept square extension $A$, replace coordinate $0$ by the two-coordinate block $\{0,24\}$ to obtain a 1603-concept family $X$, and add word $24578$ to complete the specified square on coordinates $\{1,14\}$ in the constant $00$ section.
parameters: The resulting family $Y$ has 1604 concepts, isometric dimension 25, VC dimension four, and $\operatorname{idim}(Y)-\operatorname{VC}(Y)=21$.
properties: $Y$ is an ample forbidden pc-minor with forced canonical phase sequence $Y_{1604}\to X_{1603}\to A_{579}\to B_{577}$ of graph, column, and graph type. Both graph-deletion priorities and both column representatives reach the same endpoint. Three phases attain the bound $2d-5$ at VC dimension four. On $X$, one full graph reduction is the identity, while column reduction followed by graph reduction has orders 579 and 577, so applying the two full reductions once in opposite orders gives different outputs.
